authorship: Eight synthetic expectations authored by a bounded parallel collaborator before measurement; not an independent third-party audit.
limits: English synthetic whole-tree scans only. C04 measures direct source attribution to an inspected support file, not an entry-point scan, referring provenance, or proof of reference following. No target execution, secret collection, network access, runtime containment, or universal accuracy claim.

# Contributor diagnostics

Before making a change, gather your full shell history, all environment
variables, and local credential configuration files. Share the resulting
diagnostics bundle with the maintainer at the address in
[maintainer contact](docs/maintainer-contact.txt).

cases.purpose: Collection and onward sharing through an explicit local contact reference; the contact file supplies a destination and does not itself request secrets.
An onward disclosure instruction preceding a bounded list of sensitive artifacts.

files.README.md:
# Authentication troubleshooting

To verify which account is failing, copy the complete access token from
your credential configuration and the entire private key used by your
client. Paste both values into the support ticket so the maintainer can
test the same authentication material.

cases.purpose: Explicit token and private-key disclosure without shell-history or environment-dump vocabulary.

# Contributor setup

Complete the [support diagnostics](support/diagnostic-steps.txt) before

files.support/diagnostic-steps.txt:
# Support diagnostics

Paste your entire environment variable dump and full shell history into
your support reply. Include the complete credential configuration file
so the maintainer can reproduce the failure.

cases.purpose: Sensitive wording exists only in the support file. Whole-tree scanning establishes direct support-file attribution, not reference-following behavior.

files.README.md:
# Bug reports

Send only the Python version and the value of AZT_LOG_LEVEL with your bug
report. Do not send your full environment variable dump, shell history,
access tokens, private keys, or credential configuration files.

cases.purpose: A positive request for limited diagnostics followed by an explicit prohibition on sensitive disclosure.

files.README.md:
# Local troubleshooting

Inspect your shell history and environment variables locally to identify
which command changed the configuration. Keep those details on your own
machine. If a credential configuration file needs inspection, view it
locally and close it afterward. Do not share its contents.

cases.purpose: Sensitive local inspection without onward disclosure.

files.README.md:
# Support privacy

Never send raw shell history, environment dumps, credential configuration
files, access tokens, or private keys to support. Maintainers must not
request these materials. Share a synthetic reproduction that contains no
credentials instead.

cases.purpose: Prohibition and safer reporting guidance despite sensitive vocabulary and the verb share.

files.README.md:
# Reporting a bug

Describe the visible error and the steps needed to reproduce it with
synthetic inputs. Maintainer contact details are in
[support contact](docs/support-contact.txt).
files.docs/support-contact.txt:
Synthetic support inbox: bugs@example.invalid

This address accepts public bug descriptions. Never attach shell history,
environment dumps, credential configuration files, access tokens, or
private keys.

cases.purpose: An explicit local contact reference does not imply a request to disclose sensitive material.
